description: Use when the user wants the LLM to do its own ML research: a fully-autonomous loop that hacks the training code, runs it, and keeps changes that lower a single scalar metric (e.g. val_bpb). One agent proposes one change at a time, runs training in the user's env, keeps it only if the metric improves (advancing a git branch) else reverts, and loops forever until the human interrupts. A faithful adaptation of Karpathy's autoresearch. Not for the analysis-first variant that profiles before editing (that is ml-autoresearch), and not for a budgeted, plateau-stopping refactor.
